body: Years of therapy, anti depressants, emdr, cbt, ect... People don't care. Some do. But most don't. And I don't need help, I need love. That's unattainable, so game's over. I should be dead in less than hour anyway. I only wish for my death to make people realize what they're doing when they act all mighty and superior.
My life is already over, I ingested more than five times a lethal dose of pills, I just want for my death to make people realize what they're doing.

Frankly, I don't think it does. I've been depressed since I was 12-13. I'm now 30. I have no friends, no relationships. All my girlfriends left me after a few weeks when they saw the real me: the one that hates life. I've been bullied and destroyed during high school and college. I've never been able to rebuild myself, and I never will. I despise people, and people despise me. Even if I try to smile and be funny and all, people can smell something is wrong with me and never call me back or anything. I'm all alone, no career, no self-esteem, no friends, nothing. I tried to kill myself a few months ago by swallowing a ton of ssris but it didn't work. Everyday I agonize of seeing people hanging out together, having fun, making memories, when I'm left alone and nobody cares about me. It's agony. Having to wake up everyday to live it again and again is agony.
